scope: V115/V134/V142 score construction and one initial100 admission; no new labels/outcomes opened, network, fit, native retrieval, unit tests, coefficients or serving changes.
conclusion: The collector correctly receives composite evidence before one unrestricted national initial100. Quality is partly encoded in source features/interactions, but composite competition is not calibrated to query-local density, ties or street-cloud ambiguity. The main tradeoffs are learned global nonnegative linear weights, with later typed-source heuristic parameter transfer and MAX pooling. Calling all weights arbitrary would be incorrect; calling their scores calibrated local confidence/probabilities would also be incorrect.

composite_score_structure.notation: Q20 denotes the implementation's 20bit floor bitplanes; actual Tantivy floating-point summation is distinct from an exact-real arithmetic sum. Technical reference masks attach computed evidence, never identifier features.
composite_score_structure.V115: Weighted baseline lexical components + Q20(first22 numerical fields dot their frozen weights) + Q20(other29 numerical fields dot residual weights) + inherited typed corporate/initial/activity owner-context branches. All contribute before ONE limit100 collector.
composite_score_structure.V134_primary: V115 composite + Q20(MAX(OSM geometry delta, OSM named bonus, coefficient6*MAX(supplier own, supplier temporal, continuity address))) per leaf + new admin-gated coefficient6*MAX(RNA,BANATIC confidence) per owner.
composite_score_structure.V142_primary: V115 composite + Q20(MAX(V134 leaf increment, BANO geometry delta)) + same new owner-context branches.
composite_score_structure.geometry_delta: MAX(0,(changed51-original51) dot coefficient7:58); only own5/6/7 and typed parent16/17/19 change. Source-proximity MAX is upstream of this weighted difference. Own XY is not copied to siblings.
composite_score_structure.source_MAX: Prevents selected duplicate-source votes but is MAX across already weighted increments with different typed roles/scales, not a learned local confidence comparison or a statistical-independence claim.
composite_score_structure.admission: No mandatory own-geo/name/address dominance rule or local uncertainty gate is applied at the final score boundary. A higher value of one component cannot guarantee a higher composite score.
composite_score_structure.tie_boundary: Code sorts already collected hits by score then SIRET. That post-sort does not define or prove a favorable global boundary tie selection; preserve actual collector/index semantics and report ties honestly.

quality_and_ambiguity_already_present: Baseline owngeo uses reliability .5 for declared weak query geometry, else1, with distance divided by300+query uncertainty. Increased uncertainty broadens distance support; this is a heuristic quality curve, not a measured posterior. Missing unsupported own XY has no owngeo source update.

V17 street fallback merges normalized names, refuses weak/near-tied street matches and records footprint spread, weak precision and uncertainty. This source-resolution ambiguity guard is real, but is not final candidate-density calibration.

Own address proof is coherent per complete own alias: numbered .65street+.20number/suffix+.15name, unnumbered .80street+.20name, MAX over aliases. Name and street use bounded fuzzy similarities; downstream interactions include name/address and name/geo. Name thus appears in correlated views, not independent likelihood votes.

Parent identity, parent geometry and parent portfolio name remain separate typed context. MAX geometry across legal-SIREN siblings is broadcast, not a same-physical-site equivalence or borrowed own address. Public missing-XY receivers already can receive this parent-only evidence.

Global lexical scores use global index statistics, token-count mean and MAX name/address-field branches. Some relation contexts have admin corroboration, source-degree .5/sqrt(degree) or source-owner IDF shaping. These acknowledge source specificity but are not a local composite calibration.
what_is_not_local_composite_calibration: No inspected active scoring step conditions its weights on the query's count of geographically plausible public sites, tied coordinates, street-cloud bbox/extent, same-name competitors or sibling crowding.

V142 exact-house versus fallback street precision and source-point count are recorded as metadata; both use .5/(1+minimum distance/300) and the same inherited numerical weights. There is no additional precision/count/spread-dependent composite weighting.
New named/supplier/temporal/address/owner confidences use the frozen actor coefficient6 by predeclared role transfer, not a new empirical source-specific probability calibration.

Five SIREN-cross-fitted calibrators fit nonnegative weighted pairwise logistic loss with train-only pair-difference RMS scaling and L2. They are global vectors within each heldout bucket, not per-query fitted confidence or serving vectors. Some baseline weights stay frozen while residual parameters were fitted with a fixed baseline margin.

Missing components generally appear as zero/nonexistent branches rather than explicit comprehensive missingness/ambiguity features. Source metadata can distinguish absences, but metadata alone does not adapt admission.
